name: downloads-drop
description: Notices files that land in Downloads while you work (PDFs, 3MF models, images, notes) and offers them in a band above the prompt: Attach puts @"path" mentions in the prompt box, Dismiss clears them. /downloads lists the newest files and attaches any by number. No model calls.

folder.title: Folder to watch
folder.description: The folder whose top level is watched for new files; ~ is your home folder.

extensions.title: File types
extensions.description: Comma-separated extensions that count (case-insensitive); * counts every file.

pollSeconds.title: Check every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the folder is listed. A file is offered once two checks in a row see the same size, so a download still in progress waits.

maxAgeMinutes.title: Ignore files older than (minutes)
maxAgeMinutes.description: A file last modified longer ago than this never counts as new, however long the session has run.
